keep.text: Agar main kahoon ki aapko patle hone ke liye aapko kuch bhi chhodne ki zaroorat nahi hai,
kuch bhi badalna nahi hai, sirf ek cheez kariye, glucose spike ko 40% kam kar dijiye,
khaane ka order badal dijiye,
toh aap log samjho ki aap logon ka kaam ho gaya.
Aap log patle ho jaoge.
Samjho aapke pet mein na ek wash basin hai, aap samajhna.
Blood sugar
ek drain pipe hai.
Agar seedha paani daalo basin mein toh tezi se drain ho jaayega.
Waise hi seedha carb khaayenge toh glucose tezi se spike kar jaayega.
Par agar basin mein pehle jaali lagaayein,
yaani ki fiber ki jaali,
toh fiber ek
poora ka poora kavach bana dega.
Toh paani slowly jaayega.
Toh isi tareeke se carb slowly absorb hoga.
Toh
insulin aapki dheere dheere dheere dheere spike hogi.
Aur jab dheere spike hogi insulin,
toh
crash bhi dheere hoga, aur isi wajah se aap logon ko bhookh bhi kam lagegi.
Toh sabse pehla kaam ye kariye, step 1 hai ki sabse pehle aap log kachcha salad khaiye.
Kheera, gajar, tamatar, ye saari cheezein na
ek resistant starch ki tarah kaam karti hain
aur ye aapke gut mein
jaa karke ek protective layer bana deti hai
jo
dheere dheere dheere dheere
slow karta hai insulin ki spike ko aur insulin ke crash ko bhi.
Step 2:
50% plate sabzi ki hai.
Aur step 3: 50% daal ya protein ya kuch bhi, jaise anda, chicken, ye saari cheezein khaayenge. Agar aap log non-veg nahi ho toh soyabean, tofu aur ye saari cheezein bhi kha sakte ho.
Step 4: bachi hui sabzi plus protein ke saath roti ya chawal bahut kam khaiye, kyunki aajkal roti mein gluten bahut zyada hai, bazaar waale aate mein.
Toh agar gehun khud ghar pe rakh karke pisvaa rahe ho toh usmein 5–6% gluten milega aapko. Agar aap
bahar se khareed rahe ho,
jitne bhi Aashirvaad aur ye pata nahi kaun kaun se aate jo hain,
in saare aaton mein
pandrah se
16% gluten hota hai.
Aur is poore method ko bolte hain meal sequencing.
Jo ki studies prove karti hain ki same food hai, different tareeke se ya different order mein khaaya jaaye toh 40% less
glucose spike hota hai.
Aur interesting baat pata hai kya hai?
Hamare ancestors ne bhi pehle yahi cheez ki thi.
Jo ekdam traditional method tha, pehle salad khao,
aur phir uske baad protein aur ye saari cheezein,
carb ke saath body ko load karo. Toh is tareeke se khaate the pehle bhi log.
Aur ye saari cheezein 2024 ke ek science ke research mein prove ho chuka hai.
Aur but hamari daadi, hamare dada ji log pehle isi tareeke se khaate the, aur isi liye un logon ke
upar fat nahi chadhta tha. Khoob mehnat bhi karte the, 25–25 hazaar steps chalte the poore din ke. Aaj hum logon se 10 hazaar steps chale nahi jaa rahe hain.
Par ye sirf ek trick hai.
Aap poore din mein subah ki chai se le karke pata nahi kya kya cheezein khaate ho,
kitni baar glucose spike hota hai. Jitni baar spike hoga utni baar crash hoga, aur jitni baar crash hoga aapko baar baar bhookh lagegi,
toh baar baar khaoge.
Toh itna saara khaana jab khaate rahoge, toh ek ke baad ek zyada glucose spike hoti rahegi, aur isi kaaran se aap log mote hote chale jaoge.
Aur ye saari cheezein maine
kaise control ki,
kya system banaya, ye poora ka poora system maine
ek apne health protocol mein daal diya hai. Agar aap logon ko bhi ye health protocol chahiye,
toh aap log
comment kariye HEALTH PROTOCOL. Aap logon ko
ye poora ka poora system aap logon ke paas mil jaayega. Aap logon ke paas ek link aa jaayega, aap log usse register kar lijiye.
Chaliye,
mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai.
